note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Bot update delivery
scenarios.query: Implement a webhook consumer that may receive the same Telegram update more than once.
expected_behavior: Uses update_id as the delivery idempotency key
Claims the update before side effects
Handles retries and rate limits as normal delivery behavior

scenarios.title: Userbot credential
scenarios.query: Run a Telethon importer from a user account in production.
expected_behavior: First checks whether a user account is actually required
Treats the session file as a logged-in credential
Handles FloodWaitError for the exact requested duration
Names revocation, account-ban and library-version risks

scenarios.title: Mini App authentication
scenarios.query: Authenticate a Mini App request and reject replayed or tampered initData.
expected_behavior: Verifies the original signed query string server-side
Does not trust initDataUnsafe as authentication
Checks auth_date against an explicit freshness window
Uses the correct bot-token or third-party Ed25519 verification path
